recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future concerns about choice-level standards status or cross-version extension packaging should be handled as separate infrastructure or extension-packaging work, not as a current core Observation source edit.
issue_request: FHIR-24693 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request raised against STU3 and applied for R6. It requested adding Observation.valueAttachment in the R5/R6 build as an STU item and documenting when to use Observation.valueAttachment versus Observation.derivedFrom and DiagnosticReport.presentedForm in the Observation introduction and element definitions.
initial_application: Jira identifies commit 0acff97ca003816dc9ddb57f84c591cffbd84666 as the partial 2019 application. That commit added Attachment to the old Observation value[x] and component.value[x] spreadsheet type lists and added Attachment-versus-derivedFrom guidance; the 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the applied content into the active StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Current structuredefinition-Observation.xml includes Attachment for Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x], and current observation-notes.xml lists valueAttachment and explains Attachment, derivedFrom, DiagnosticReport.media, and DiagnosticReport.presentedForm usage. The Jira/Zulip follow-up established that marking only the valueAttachment choice as Trial Use was not supported. The related FHIR-24695 R4-extension issue is already represented by combined-branch audit commit 8829d816a947f849a0b678c91fd2cad02f2e9cef.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current-build Observation source already satisfies the requested native Attachment choice and usage-guidance requirements; adding duplicate prose would not change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Requested the R4/inter-version extension side of the same valueAttachment work and is already audited on the combined branch.
